maya: Quick sync — I opened PR #4527 to consolidate the examples across py/ts/go. The main goal was to make resume/token examples clearer and show a tiny retry/backoff pattern. Can people glance?
eli: On it. Do you have a preview link?
deploy-bot: Preview deployed: https://deployments.redwood.dev/docs/pr-4527 :rocket:
qi: Quick scan — TS example uses `client.stream(...)` but doesn't show retry hooks or where to store the resume token. Can we show one short pattern for that?
tom: I can add a compact retry helper for TS, eg:
```ts
async function withRetry(fn) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    try { return await fn(); } catch (e) {
      if (i === 2) throw e;
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100 * (i + 1)));
    }
  }
}
```
Use `withRetry(() => client.stream(...))`.
eli: The Go snippet lost the pagination resume token — it currently shows `pageToken` but not `resumeToken`. I'll restore a minimal example showing how to persist a token to disk.
maya: For Python I changed the iterator to show the token being captured: 
```py
client = RedwoodClient()
for chunk in client.stream_messages(conv_id, resume_token=token):
    process(chunk)
    token = chunk.resume_token  # persist this for next session
```
But not sure if `resume_token` is the exact attr name; please verify.
qi: We should standardize on two patterns: 1) stateless resume where you pass the last token back on reconnect, and 2) stateful periodic checkpointing (save every N chunks). Keep examples short.
eli: Agreed. I'll rework the Go example to match those two patterns. Also noted a wording nit: avoid "cursor" vs "resume token" interchangeably — pick one term and add a parenthetical.
maya: Good call. I'll make a small note in the docs intro explaining "resume token (server-provided opaque marker)".
tom: Also added a short mention of the backpressure knobs in TS — `maxConcurrency` vs `batchSize` — and linked to the runtime config page.
qi: Heads-up: there's a broken internal link in the PR to /guides/streaming -> should be /guides/streaming/resume. I left a line comment.
deploy-bot: Docs preview updated: https://deployments.redwood.dev/docs/pr-4527 (build 12)
eli: I pushed the Go fix (tiny), and clarified the field name to `resume_token` in the YAML frontmatter examples.
maya: If no objections I'll merge after tom/qi push their tiny changes. @tom @qi please push by EOD if possible.
qi: I can get mine in this afternoon. Also suggest adding a one-liner under "Retries" about idempotency when resending on reconnect.
tom: Pushed TS retry wrapper + note about idempotency and `maxConcurrency`.
eli: LGTM after confirm of the attr name. :thumbsup:
maya: Merging in 10 unless objections.
qi: No objections from me.
maya: Merged. Thanks all! :tada:
